title: Remedies for enforcement of rights conferred by this Part

provision_refs.quote: (1) The right to move the Supreme Court by appropriate proceedings for the enforcement of the rights conferred by this Part is guaranteed. (2) The Supreme Court shall have power to issue directions or orders or writs, including writs in the nature of habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, quo warranto and certiorari, whichever may be appropriate, for the enforcement of any of the rights conferred by this Part.

verification.notes: Linked to every Part III right because Article 32(1) refers to enforcement of 'the rights conferred by this Part'.
